messages.content:
"想像一下，你是一位同時熱愛音樂和和朋友玩撲克牌的音樂家。有一天，你決定在家裡舉辦一場撲克牌遊戲。你邀請了三位朋友，他們的名字分別是John、Sarah和Mike。在德州撲克遊戲中，John手上的牌是紅心2、方塊3、黑桃4、梅花5和方塊6。Sarah手上的牌是紅心3、方塊4、黑桃5、梅花6和方塊7。Mike手上的牌是紅心4、方塊5、黑桃6、梅花7和方塊8。誰贏得了這場遊戲呢？

遊戲結束後，你們決定一起演奏音樂。你拿起吉他，開始彈奏一首C大調的歌曲。但是，你忘記了C大調音階的音符。你能告訴我它們是什麼嗎？

之後，你決定做一個物理實驗。你以初速度10米/秒發射了一個小物體。5秒後，你注意到物體已經停止加速。在這段時間內，物體究竟移動了多遠？"

function.name: poker_game_winner
function.description: Identify the winner in a poker game based on the cards. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

cards.description: An object containing the player name as key and the cards as string values in a list, for example '7 of diamonds'.

type.description: Type of poker game. Defaults to 'Texas Holdem'

function.name: calculate_displacement
function.description: Calculates the displacement of an object in motion given initial velocity, time, and acceleration. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

initial_velocity.description: The initial velocity of the object in m/s.

time.description: The time in seconds that the object has been in motion.

acceleration.description: The acceleration of the object in m/s^2.

function.name: musical_scale
function.description: Get the musical scale of a specific key in music theory. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

key.description: The musical key for which the scale will be found.
